## Release validation

- [ ] Native Android unit tests and release lint pass.
- [ ] Gradle builds the universal APK.
- [ ] Android SDK tools verify the APK and its signatures.
- [ ] Production credentials are external; no signing keys or passwords are committed.
- [ ] Any device smoke tests and remaining release prerequisites are documented.
